ADDED i3: Two empty strings are identical: no edits required.
ADDED i4: A single insertion turns "" into "a".
ADDED i5: Deleting every character of a 7-character string yields "".
ADDED i6: Deleting the 'r' turns "frog" into "fog".
ADDED i7: No characters are shared, so all 3 must be substituted.
ADDED i8: Distance is symmetric: "elephant" <-> "hippo" costs 7 either way.
ADDED i9: Completely disjoint strings of length 5 and 8 cost 8.
ADDED i10: A single substitution ('e' -> 'a') turns "hello" into "hallo".
